I added `tests/test_refunds.py` with one test, and it passes.

The test builds an invoice with a $100.00 subtotal and $8.00 tax, so the total is 10,800 cents. It then checks that `refund(invoice, 10_801)` raises `ValueError` with the message "refund exceeds invoice total".

I only ran the new test file, not the full suite.

`refund()` doesn't implement the stored decision that refunds over 50,000 cents get `pending_approval` status. It also doesn't emit the `ledger.refund_issued` audit event. I left both alone because you only asked for the rejection test.
Thanks. Heads up: CI runs pytest with `-W error`, so any DeprecationWarning fails the build there even when it passes locally. Keep that in mind for anything you write here.
